title: Pullback of the sheaf associated to a module along a morphism of affine schemes
statement:
Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings and $\psi=\operatorname{Spec}\varphi:\operatorname{Spec}S\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ the induced morphism of affine schemes [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. For an $R$-module $M$ let $\widetilde M$ and $\tau:M\to\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec}R,\widetilde M)$ be as in [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections] (and likewise for $S$-modules on $\operatorname{Spec}S$), and let $\psi^*$ be the pullback of modules [def-pc-module-pullback], left adjoint to $\psi_*$, with unit $\eta:\mathcal G\to\psi_*\psi^*\mathcal G$. Then there is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}S}$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] $\theta_M:\psi^*\widetilde M\xrightarrow{\sim}\widetilde{S\otimes_RM}$, natural in $M$, such that for every $m\in M$
$$\theta_M\bigl(\eta_{\widetilde M}(\tau(m))\bigr)=\tau(1\otimes m)\quad\text{in }\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec}S,\widetilde{S\otimes_RM}),$$
where $\eta_{\widetilde M}(\tau(m))\in(\psi_*\psi^*\widetilde M)(\operatorname{Spec}R)=\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec}S,\psi^*\widetilde M)$.
